findings.criterion: frozen v5 benchmark specification path and hash identity
findings.affected_row: line 17 frozen v5 benchmark specification binding
findings.observed_fact: The adapter contract names research/hybrid-recsys-v5/03_benchmark/benchmark_spec_v5.json, which does not exist in the frozen worktree. The E4 parent manifest binds canonical-LF SHA-256 acef1c62cc2a9a3ae04fdf2f4b2fb24b3eb8d2634f15e085fbe1878be8dc166d to backend/docs/chatbot/seed-product/benchmark-spec-v5.json, which does exist and hashes to that value.
findings.impact: A future adapter manifest cannot unambiguously bind the frozen benchmark specification by both path and hash. This is a source/config identity defect requiring E4 regeneration.

findings.criterion: exact-command safety, namespace, hardware, source-state and receipt enforcement
findings.affected_row: E4-LGCN-000-PREFLIGHT; E4-LGCN-010-CLONE; E4-LGCN-020-CHECKOUT; E4-LGCN-030-VERIFY-SOURCE; E4-LGCN-060-PREPROCESS-GATE; E4-LGCN-070-TRAIN-AND-INTEGRATED-EVALUATE; E4-LGCN-090-FINALIZE-RECEIPTS
findings.observed_fact: The preflight only checks a literal root, marker existence and successful nvidia-smi output; it does not assert GPU identity/index/capacity/free VRAM, resource-wrapper existence/hash/enforcement, marker contents or reparse/nested namespace safety. Source verification prints dirty/submodule state without rejecting it. The preprocessing gate checks only property presence and a label. Finalization lists and hashes files but does not validate required receipts, schemas, duplicate/case-colliding names or emit its declared manifest. Several commands do not create their declared receipts.

namespace map, phase sequence, resource envelope and receipt requirements

findings.impact: The exact strings do not mechanically enforce several safety and provenance claims stated by their failure semantics. They must not be made executable or confirmed without replacement in a newly frozen E4 packet.

findings.affected_row: packet global_prerequisites and phases; commands 040 and 060; adapter lines 27 and 133; plan lines 46 and 104
findings.observed_fact: E4 repeatedly assigns E5 responsibility for supplying the runtime/dependency lock, raw-to-processed receipt, exact adapter argv and a new execution/confirmation packet. The authoritative E5 contract is audit-only and requires blocker remediation, a new frozen E4 packet, a new E5 audit and only then explicit user confirmation.
